en.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5 Drops Dual-Wielding Pistols and Edgerunners Content
en.summary: Night City is expanding its horizons with the upcoming 2.5 update for Cyberpunk 2077, bringing new ways to play and interact with the world. This substantial patch injects fresh content inspired by the popular Edgerunners anime, alongside significant gameplay additions.
en.body:
Get ready to paint Night City red with **Cyberpunk 2077**'s latest major update, version 2.5, which is set to roll out on October 22, 2026. This highly anticipated patch injects a significant dose of new content and gameplay enhancements, directly tying into the ongoing narrative and aesthetic of the **Edgerunners** anime. Players can expect a host of new experiences, from engaging side quests to deep visual customization, ensuring that even seasoned mercs will find fresh challenges and ways to express themselves in the sprawling metropolis.

## New Adventures in Night City
The update introduces several new side quests designed to deepen the player's immersion in the world of **Cyberpunk 2077**. Fans of the **Edgerunners** anime will particularly enjoy 'Clampdown,' a new gig that acts as a narrative bridge, set before the events of the anime's second season. During this quest, players can acquire a new five-piece gear set inspired by the character King from Season 2, adding a stylish new look to their arsenal. For those seeking lore and exploration, the 'Welcome to Paradise!' side quest offers a guided tour of Night City narrated by its founder, Richard Night, promising a journey to uncover hidden mysteries. Furthermore, an extension of the 'Fool on the Hill' questline will add new tarot cards to discover, encouraging further exploration and engagement with the game's world.

## Enhanced Player Expression and Combat
Beyond new narrative content, Update 2.5 brings substantial gameplay and customization options. A major highlight is the 'Double Trouble' perk within the Cool skill tree, which unlocks the ability to dual-wield pistols and revolvers from the Power category, introducing a dynamic new playstyle for players who love to go in guns blazing. This is complemented by new poses in Photo Mode, perfect for showcasing your newfound dual-wielding prowess. For those who crave unique aesthetics, the update introduces 'Glamdocs,' specialized shops where players can customize the visual appearance of their arm cyberware, including Mantis Blades, Gorilla Arms, Monowire, and Projectile Launch Systems, with unique skins and animations. The update also includes a new radio station featuring tracks from the **Edgerunners** series, further enhancing the anime's integration into the game. Additionally, frames from the **Cyberpunk Trading Card Game** will be added to Photo Mode, allowing for even more personalized screenshots.

## What's Next
**Cyberpunk 2077** Update 2.5 is slated for release on October 22, 2026, for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S, with a **Nintendo Switch 2** release to follow. The update also includes baked-in Mod.io support on all major platforms (excluding the Switch 2) and an FOV setting for consoles, marking a significant step towards cross-platform modding and player accessibility.

content_raw: CD Projekt has revealed what to expect from the Cyberpunk 2077 2.5 update, which ties in with the release of Netflix anime Edgerunners 2 . Edgerunners content includes a new side quest called Clampdown, which is set before the events of Edgerunners 2 ( CD Projekt recently confirmed that Edgerunners 2 is set in 2078 , just one year after the game itself). During this quest you’ll get a new 5-piece gear set based on the character King from Season 2. There’s also a new radio station that has tracks from the Edgerunners series. But there’s plenty more coming with 2.5 unrelated to Edgerunners, including more side quests. The Welcome to Paradise! side quest takes you on a journey to uncover a mystery and explore Night City on a guided tour narrated by Richard Night, the founder of Night City itself. There’s also a new side quest that acts as an extension of Fool on the Hill, which includes new tarot cards. Meanwhile, 2.5 lets you customize your hand cyberware, which will let you give your Mantis Blades, Gorilla Arms, Monowire or Projectile Launch System implants a new look. Each Glamdoc is located in a unique shop, along with their own intro scene with voiceover and animations, and offers a unique catalog of cyberware skins with customizable t enough. The new Double Trouble perk in the Cool tree (along with four auxiliary perks) introduces an entirely new playstyle, allowing you to dual-wield Pistols and Revolvers from the Power category. Added frames from the Cyberpunk Trading Card Game to Photo Mode, allowing you to make your preem shots look like custom cards. Added new poses in Photo Mode to show off your dual-wielding prowess. Mod the World Added Cross-Platform Mod Support, powered by mod.io, a first step into cross-platform modding that allows you to easily browse and install a selection of player-created mods directly from the in-game menu. More mods will become available over time. The feature is available on PC, Mac, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro and Xbox Series X|S. Upgrading the World Welcome to Paradise ! Added a new side quest that takes you on a journey to uncover a mystery and explore Night City on a guided tour narrated by Richard Night. It unlocks after completing The Heist and reaching level 15 Street Cred. Added 12 new Minor Arcana Tarot Cards to discover across Night City. The Tarot menu now has separate sections for Major and Minor Arcana. The new tarot cards are part of a new side quest, an extension of Fool on the Hill , which activates after scanning any of the new cards. Collect them all to get a special reward. Quality of Life Saves in the “Load Game” menu are now grouped by separate playthroughs. Added item filters to apartment and vehicle stashes. Modded saves in the "Load Game" menu are now marked with a dedicated icon. Please note that achievements and trophies cannot be earned while playing on console from a modded save file. Added an FOV (Field Of View) slider on consoles. Updated the selection of AMD FSR options. FSR
